facts.value: These courses aim to convey communicative and intercultural foreign language skills, refresh and complete existing basic knowledge in the English language, and provide the subject vocabulary as well as a first insight into general aspects of the economy in English-speaking countries.
Completion of level A2/B1 of the GER or 26-40 points in the placement test.

In the Business English Foundation Course, you learn vocabulary and phrases specifically for the business world. A variety of exercises aim to foster linguistic and conceptual understanding of current topics and form the basis for discussions and written exercises on various economic topics. The reading and writing component of the course will be assessed in the last week of the semester in a 90-minute written exam. A graded certificate is issued for passing the exam.
A maximum of 20 participants is allowed in all courses.
90 Euro for Business English Foundation (13 double hours, including final exam).
